remaining_limitations: The physical map is a local first-order, common-congruence, constant-coefficient low-redshift hypothesis. It is not a source-derived finite-redshift Bianchi transfer, a general tilt history, or a measurement of all kinematic components.
The beta interpretation fixes matter-versus-radiation frame and coherent-velocity response. Spatial homogeneity alone does not imply constant velocity across redshift.
Probability, simultaneous support and confidence-union claims condition on fixed correctly specified covariance and linear response, and at least one included nuisance model being valid.
Directional quantity is apparent log-H anisotropy excluding coherent velocity and monopole. Fractional-H interpretation is first order; it is not an absolute H0 or a general H(z,n) determination.
All six reported axis interval hulls include zero. This does not contradict a joint multi-parameter rejection and does not itself measure a nonzero directional Hubble anomaly.
Typed views do not add information or power beyond the same full Gaussian GLS likelihood. Their contribution is representation, assumption tracking and transparent projection.
This pass did not rerun raw catalogue extraction, cosmic covariance pair sums, arbitrary physical transfer functions or a full repository suite.
